rules:
# Local Semgrep rules for the finding-identity harness (--analyzer semgrep).
#
# Written for this study, not taken from the Semgrep registry, so that runs are offline and
# pinned. They cover common security and quality patterns in Python, JavaScript and
# TypeScript, and deliberately mix rule shapes, because Semgrep's match_based_id depends on
# the rule's formula and metavariable bindings: plain patterns with and without
# metavariables, pattern-either, patterns with pattern-not / pattern-inside, metavariable
# filters, and taint mode.
rules:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Python
  - id: py-eval-exec
    languages: [python]
    severity: ERROR
    message: Dynamic code execution with $FN on $ARG
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-95", confidence: MEDIUM}
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: eval($ARG, ...)
          - pattern: exec($ARG, ...)
          - pattern: $FN($ARG, ...)
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $FN
          regex: ^(eval|exec)$
      - pattern-not: $FN("...", ...)

  - id: py-subprocess-shell
    languages: [python]
    severity: ERROR
    message: subprocess.$CALL with shell=True
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-78", confidence: HIGH}
    pattern: subprocess.$CALL(..., shell=True, ...)

  - id: py-os-command
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: Command run through the shell
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-78", confidence: MEDIUM}
    pattern-either:
      - pattern: os.system(...)
      - pattern: os.popen(...)
      - pattern: os.spawnl(...)
      - pattern: commands.getoutput(...)

  - id: py-pickle-load
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: Deserializing with $MOD.$FN can execute code
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-502", confidence: MEDIUM}
    patterns:
      - pattern: $MOD.$FN(...)
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $MOD
          regex: ^(pickle|cPickle|dill|shelve|marshal)$
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $FN
          regex: ^(load|loads|open)$

  - id: py-yaml-unsafe-load
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: yaml.load without a safe Loader
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-502", confidence: HIGH}
    patterns:
      - pattern: yaml.load(...)
      - pattern-not: yaml.load(..., Loader=yaml.SafeLoader, ...)
      - pattern-not: yaml.load(..., Loader=SafeLoader, ...)
      - pattern-not: yaml.load(..., Loader=yaml.CSafeLoader, ...)

  - id: py-weak-hash
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: Weak hash function hashlib.$H
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-328", confidence: MEDIUM}
    patterns:
      - pattern: hashlib.$H(...)
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $H
          regex: ^(md5|sha1|md4)$
      - pattern-not: hashlib.$H(..., usedforsecurity=False, ...)

  - id: py-requests-no-verify
    languages: [python]
    severity: ERROR
    message: TLS verification disabled in requests.$M
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-295", confidence: HIGH}
    pattern: requests.$M(..., verify=False, ...)

  - id: py-sql-format
    languages: [python]
    severity: ERROR
    message: SQL built by string formatting passed to $CUR.execute
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-89", confidence: MEDIUM}
    pattern-either:
      - pattern: $CUR.execute("..." % ..., ...)
      - pattern: $CUR.execute("...".format(...), ...)
      - pattern: $CUR.execute(f"...", ...)
      - pattern: $CUR.execute("..." + $X, ...)

  - id: py-django-raw-sql
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: Raw SQL in $QS.$RAW
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-89", confidence: LOW}
    patterns:
      - pattern: $QS.$RAW($SQL, ...)
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $RAW
          regex: ^(raw|extra|RawSQL)$
      - pattern-not: $QS.$RAW("...", ...)

  - id: py-mark-safe
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: mark_safe on a non-literal disables HTML escaping
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-79", confidence: LOW}
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: mark_safe($X)
          - pattern: django.utils.safestring.mark_safe($X)
      - pattern-not: mark_safe("...")

  - id: py-tempfile-mktemp
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: tempfile.mktemp is race-prone
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-377", confidence: HIGH}
    pattern: tempfile.mktemp(...)

  - id: py-assert-used
    languages: [python]
    severity: INFO
    message: assert is removed under python -O
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-703", confidence: LOW}
    paths:
      exclude: ["tests/", "test_*.py", "*_test.py", "conftest.py"]
    pattern-either:
      - pattern: assert $COND
      - pattern: assert $COND, $MSG

  - id: py-hardcoded-secret
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: Possible hard-coded secret in $NAME
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-798", confidence: LOW}
    patterns:
      - pattern: $NAME = "$VALUE"
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $NAME
          regex: (?i).*(password|passwd|secret|api_key|token)$
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $VALUE
          regex: .{4,}

  - id: py-flask-debug
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: Flask app run with debug=True
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-489", confidence: MEDIUM}
    pattern: $APP.run(..., debug=True, ...)

  - id: py-bare-except-pass
    languages: [python]
    severity: INFO
    message: Exception swallowed by a bare except
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-703", confidence: LOW}
    pattern: |
      try:
        ...
      except:
        pass

  - id: py-broad-except-pass
    languages: [python]
    severity: INFO
    message: $EXC swallowed without handling
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-703", confidence: LOW}
    pattern-either:
      - pattern: |
          try:
            ...
          except $EXC:
            pass
      - pattern: |
          try:
            ...
          except $EXC as $E:
            pass

  - id: py-requests-no-timeout
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: requests.$M without a timeout can hang
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-400", confidence: MEDIUM}
    patterns:
      - pattern: requests.$M(...)
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $M
          regex: ^(get|post|put|patch|delete|head|options|request)$
      - pattern-not: requests.$M(..., timeout=$T, ...)

  - id: py-logging-fstring
    languages: [python]
    severity: INFO
    message: f-string formatted eagerly in $LOG.$M
    metadata: {confidence: LOW}
    patterns:
      - pattern: $LOG.$M(f"...", ...)
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $M
          regex: ^(debug|info|warning|error|exception|critical)$

  - id: py-csrf-exempt
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: CSRF protection disabled for $VIEW
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-352", confidence: MEDIUM}
    pattern: |
      @csrf_exempt
      def $VIEW(...):
        ...

  - id: py-subprocess-call
    languages: [python]
    severity: INFO
    message: subprocess.$CALL runs an external program
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-78", confidence: LOW}
    patterns:
      - pattern: subprocess.$CALL($CMD, ...)
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $CALL
          regex: ^(run|call|check_call|check_output|Popen)$

  - id: py-open-no-encoding
    languages: [python]
    severity: INFO
    message: open($PATH) in text mode without an explicit encoding
    metadata: {confidence: LOW}
    patterns:
      - pattern: open($PATH, ...)
      - pattern-not: open($PATH, ..., encoding=$E, ...)
      - pattern-not: open($PATH, "=~/b/", ...)
      - pattern-not: open($PATH, mode="=~/b/", ...)

  - id: py-mutable-default
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: Mutable default argument $ARG in $FN
    metadata: {confidence: HIGH}
    pattern-either:
      - pattern: |
          def $FN(..., $ARG=[], ...):
            ...
      - pattern: |
          def $FN(..., $ARG={}, ...):
            ...
      - pattern: |
          def $FN(..., $ARG=set(), ...):
            ...

  - id: py-open-redirect
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: Redirect to a URL taken from the request
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-601", confidence: LOW}
    mode: taint
    pattern-sources:
      - pattern: request.args.get(...)
      - pattern: request.GET.get(...)
      - pattern: request.values.get(...)
    pattern-sinks:
      - pattern: redirect(...)
      - pattern: HttpResponseRedirect(...)

  - id: py-path-traversal
    languages: [python]
    severity: WARNING
    message: File opened with a path taken from the request
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-22", confidence: LOW}
    mode: taint
    pattern-sources:
      - pattern: request.$ATTR.get(...)
      - pattern: request.$ATTR[...]
    pattern-sinks:
      - pattern: open(...)
      - pattern: send_file(...)
      - pattern: os.path.join(...)

  # --------------------------------------------------------- JavaScript / TypeScript
  - id: js-eval
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: ERROR
    message: Dynamic code execution with $FN
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-95", confidence: MEDIUM}
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: eval($X)
          - pattern: new Function(...)
          - pattern: $FN($X, ...)
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $FN
          regex: ^(eval|setTimeout|setInterval)$
      - pattern-not: $FN("...", ...)
      - pattern-not: $FN(function (...) {...}, ...)
      - pattern-not: $FN((...) => {...}, ...)
      - pattern-not: $FN((...) => $Y, ...)

  - id: js-inner-html
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: WARNING
    message: Assignment to $EL.$PROP can inject HTML
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-79", confidence: LOW}
    patterns:
      - pattern: $EL.$PROP = $VAL
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $PROP
          regex: ^(innerHTML|outerHTML)$
      - pattern-not: $EL.$PROP = "..."

  - id: js-document-write
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: WARNING
    message: document.write with dynamic content
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-79", confidence: LOW}
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: document.write($X)
          - pattern: document.writeln($X)
      - pattern-not: document.write("...")

  - id: js-child-process
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: ERROR
    message: Shell command run with child_process.$FN
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-78", confidence: MEDIUM}
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: require('child_process').$FN($CMD, ...)
          - pattern: child_process.$FN($CMD, ...)
          - pattern: $CP.$FN($CMD, ...)
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $FN
          regex: ^(exec|execSync)$
      - pattern-not: $CP.$FN("...", ...)

  - id: js-dangerously-set-html
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: WARNING
    message: dangerouslySetInnerHTML bypasses React escaping
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-79", confidence: LOW}
    pattern: "{dangerouslySetInnerHTML: $X}"

  - id: js-weak-random
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: INFO
    message: Math.random is not a secure random source
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-338", confidence: LOW}
    pattern: Math.random()

  - id: js-weak-hash
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: WARNING
    message: Weak hash $ALG
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-328", confidence: MEDIUM}
    patterns:
      - pattern: $CRYPTO.createHash("$ALG")
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $ALG
          regex: ^(md5|sha1)$

  - id: js-console-log
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: INFO
    message: console.$M left in code
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-532", confidence: LOW}
    patterns:
      - pattern: console.$M(...)
      - metavariable-regex:
          metavariable: $M
          regex: ^(log|debug)$

  - id: js-tls-reject-unauthorized
    languages: [javascript, typescript]
    severity: ERROR
    message: TLS certificate checks disabled
    metadata: {cwe: "CWE-295", confidence: HIGH}
    pattern-either:
      - pattern: "{rejectUnauthorized: false}"
      - pattern: process.env.NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = "0"

metavars.$MSG: "expected view func if endpoint is not provided."

metavars.$COND: not base_url or subdomain url_scheme or base_url is None!=bool(subdomain or url_scheme)

metavars.$X: 'Finding template added successfully. You may edit it here.'.format(reverse("edit_template"args(template.id)))

"
"""+self.get_html()+"
""
"
bleach.clean(markdown_text tags markdown_tags attributes markdown_attrs css_sanitizer CSSSanitizer(allowed_css_properties markdown_styles))
html%(icon color icon common_fields endpoints extra_fields)
